question.text: Which of the following does NOT belong in the 'Components of Impact Reporting' list given in Chapter 7.3.2?

answer.text: An executive summary aimed at all stakeholders
Description of the scope of the SIA
Details of stakeholder involvement and methods of data collection

explanation.text: The Logic: Chapter 7.3.2 lists: executive summary, organisation info, scope description, stakeholder involvement, calculation details (if monetary), impact map, assumptions/limitations, audit trail, impact scorecard. Personal tax returns of promoters are NOT a listed component. The Trap: The promoter-tax-return option is plausibly absurd — tests whether the candidate reads the list closely. Cross-Exam Context: Personal tax-return disclosure is required in offer documents (XV RA promoter disclosures) but not in SIR. Assessor's Pro-Tip: Use the Ch 7.3.2 component list as a literal checklist on your engagement binder. Tick each as drafted. If a section is N/A for a specific engagement, mark 'N/A with rationale' — never 'skip silently'.
